nodes.label: Filament\Models\Contracts\FilamentUser interface
nodes.rationale: Sem essa interface, Filament\Http\Middleware\Authenticate só libera acesso quando config('app.env')==='local', bloqueando acesso em staging/produção mesmo com login válido.

nodes.label: routes/web.php POST/PATCH source-channels REST routes
nodes.rationale: Filament 5 Resources só registram rotas GET/HEAD; o submit real do formulário é via Livewire AJAX, não HTTP POST/PATCH tradicional — testes RED (Plan 08-03) exigem POST/PATCH diretos, então rotas explícitas foram adicionadas reusando a mesma lógica de negócio.

nodes.label: Filament Resource GET/HEAD-only routing pattern
nodes.rationale: Filament 5 Resources only register GET/HEAD; actual form submit occurs via Livewire AJAX. Feature tests requiring raw POST/PATCH need explicit routes/web.php entries reusing the same business logic.

nodes.label: destination_channels.oauth_expired_flag column
nodes.rationale: Necessário para tornar o estado OAuth 'expired' observável no painel — sem produtor real no pipeline, o badge nunca mostraria 'expired'.

nodes.label: Sidecar HTTP interno em thread daemon (antes do ciclo do pipeline)
nodes.rationale: Thread posicionada ANTES de run_pipeline_once() para garantir que o painel Laravel tenha acesso ao sidecar imediatamente após o boot, sem esperar minutos do primeiro ciclo (download+transcrição+corte).
nodes.norm_label: sidecar http interno em thread daemon (antes do ciclo do pipeline)

nodes.label: Filament $isLazy=false widget pattern
nodes.rationale: Filament 5 widgets são lazy por padrão (renderizam placeholder via x-intersect); sem $isLazy=false o conteúdo e wire:poll não aparecem no HTML inicial, quebrando tanto testes síncronos quanto a UX real do operador.

nodes.label: nginx bind mount painel fix (404 puro)
nodes.rationale: Todos os projetos do container nginx compartilhado precisam ser montados TANTO no serviço php QUANTO no serviço nginx — nginx precisa do root físico para try_files/estáticos antes de repassar ao php-fpm; um bind mount só no php causa 404 puro do nginx.
nodes.norm_label: nginx bind mount painel fix (404 puro)

nodes.label: docker exec / Docker socket bridge anti-pattern
nodes.rationale: Montar /var/run/docker.sock no container php compartilhado por ~8 projetos Laravel independentes daria a QUALQUER um deles controle total sobre todos os containers do host — escalada de privilégio inaceitável; substituído por sidecar HTTP interno (Pattern 3).
nodes.norm_label: docker exec / docker socket bridge anti-pattern

nodes.label: Pattern 3: ponte HTTP interna clip-processor↔painel
nodes.rationale: Substitui docker exec por 2 endpoints Flask internos (resolve-channel, reject-clip) na rede docker 'internal', preservando exit codes/side-effects de rejeitar.py sem expor Docker socket.

nodes.label: Pitfall: Redis connection('pipeline') vs default (DB0 vs DB1)
nodes.rationale: Pipeline Python usa Redis DB 0 sem especificar db=; Laravel usa REDIS_DB=1 para sessão/cache — widget de cota deve usar uma conexão nomeada 'pipeline' (DB0), não a default do Laravel, ou sempre lerá 0.
nodes.norm_label: pitfall: redis connection('pipeline') vs default (db0 vs db1)

nodes.label: Laravel Http adapter for SDK (enables Http::fake())
nodes.rationale: SDK usa GuzzleHttpClient nativo por padrão; Http::fake() não intercepta Guzzle direto — TelegramHttpClientHandler delega para Illuminate Http facade para permitir testes com Http::fake()/assertSent().
nodes.norm_label: laravel http adapter for sdk (enables http::fake())

nodes.label: Redis SET NX dedup pattern (tg:dedup:{update_id})
nodes.rationale: SET NX is atomic; check-then-set (two ops) is not atomic and creates race conditions where duplicate commands corrupt clip state (e.g. double reject deletes file twice).

nodes.label: Pitfall: CSRF blocking Telegram webhook (419)
nodes.rationale: Telegram sends no CSRF token or Sec-Fetch-Site header, so Laravel's PreventRequestForgery middleware must explicitly exclude telegramcanal and internal/pipeline-event routes.

nodes.label: Pitfall: Python→Laravel via wrong Host header (404)
nodes.rationale: POST to http://nginx without explicit Host header routes to default_server vhost instead of canaldecortes.local, causing 404.
nodes.norm_label: pitfall: python→laravel via wrong host header (404)

nodes.label: QuotaManager per-channel Redis key design

nodes.label: OAuth testing-mode token expiry warning (7 days)
nodes.rationale: Google OAuth apps not verified for Production expire refresh tokens every 7 days for sensitive scopes like youtube.upload; requires Production verification.
nodes.norm_label: oauth testing-mode token expiry warning (7 days)

nodes.label: Pitfall: Quota Cega — shared GCP project quota
nodes.rationale: Quota belongs to the GCP project not the OAuth credential/channel; multiple channels in one project share the 10,000 unit/day pool and can silently block all uploads.
nodes.norm_label: pitfall: quota cega — shared gcp project quota

nodes.label: Pitfall: OAuth App in Testing Mode Breaks Weekly
nodes.rationale: Unverified OAuth apps get 7-day refresh tokens for sensitive scopes; apps failing compliance audit silently upload as private.
nodes.norm_label: pitfall: oauth app in testing mode breaks weekly

nodes.label: Pitfall: Routing Clip to Wrong Channel Destroys Niche
nodes.rationale: Without niche/destination_channel_id columns, clips of different niches compete in the same publish queue and can be misrouted.
nodes.norm_label: pitfall: routing clip to wrong channel destroys niche

nodes.label: Pitfall: Filament Auto-Generated Resources Break on ENUM Columns
nodes.rationale: php artisan make:filament-resource --generate silently skips ENUM columns, generating free-text inputs that let operators write invalid state values, corrupting the pipeline state machine.
nodes.norm_label: pitfall: filament auto-generated resources break on enum columns

nodes.label: Pitfall: Laravel Writes Conflict with Python Pipeline Mid-Transaction
nodes.rationale: Two separate processes writing the same MySQL rows with no distributed lock can flip clip status incorrectly; requires SELECT ... FOR UPDATE / lockForUpdate() and a clear state-transition ownership boundary.
nodes.norm_label: pitfall: laravel writes conflict with python pipeline mid-transaction

nodes.label: Pitfall: Webhook Receives Duplicate Updates on Server Errors
nodes.rationale: Telegram webhook delivery is at-least-once; non-2xx or timeout triggers retries, so idempotency via update_id tracking must be built in from day one.
nodes.norm_label: pitfall: webhook receives duplicate updates on server errors

nodes.label: Pitfall: n8n Still Running Telegram Bot in Parallel After Migration
nodes.rationale: If n8n's Telegram webhook isn't explicitly deregistered before Laravel's is registered, updates route to whichever is registered last, silently breaking the other.
nodes.norm_label: pitfall: n8n still running telegram bot in parallel after migration

nodes.label: Pitfall: Content ID Claim Despite Watermark
nodes.rationale: Content ID fingerprints audio/visual content independently of any visual watermark; blacklist of high-risk source channels matters far more than watermarking.
nodes.norm_label: pitfall: content id claim despite watermark

nodes.label: Pitfall: Blacklist Check Happens Too Late in the Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Checking blacklist only at publish time wastes download/transcription/AI compute; must be enforced at RSS ingestion, the earliest possible step.
nodes.norm_label: pitfall: blacklist check happens too late in the pipeline

nodes.label: Pitfall: Filament Delete Button Deletes MySQL Row Without Deleting Files
nodes.rationale: Filament's default delete only removes the Eloquent row; associated clip/thumbnail files remain on disk unless a model observer or dispatched job also deletes them.
nodes.norm_label: pitfall: filament delete button deletes mysql row without deleting files

nodes.label: Laravel 13 version choice (not 11)
nodes.rationale: Laravel 11 reached EOL March 2026; Laravel 13 offers longest security-patch coverage (through March 2028) with zero breaking changes from 12.

nodes.label: Filament 5.x version choice (not 3)
nodes.rationale: Filament v5 is current stable, compatible with Laravel 13 and Livewire v4; v3 is superseded.

nodes.label: Boundary rule: painel reads directly, writes via sidecar
nodes.rationale: For reads, painel goes directly to source (MySQL/Redis/disk); for actions touching disk/process, painel must call the sidecar HTTP API rather than touch the pipeline filesystem directly — replaces prior docker exec / Docker socket pattern.
nodes.norm_label: boundary rule: painel reads directly, writes via sidecar

nodes.label: Rules for destructive operations
nodes.rationale: List before delete in two steps, always use absolute paths, filter DB-vs-disk comparisons by key not filename, never blind-prune Docker, backup before mass DELETE.
